evidence:
Scoped to check 24 structural wiring. The current workbook Quality Checks!D25 and staged skill supersede Internal Quality Checks!D25's retired reward.toml wording. Frozen task/tests/scoring.toml:1-11 contains exactly render/constraints=0, weights functional=.6/polish=.2/visual=.2 and functional floor=.05, byte-identical to the frozen template. All five judge headers/scoring tables equal their template counterparts: gates/{render,constraints}/judge.toml:1-21 have Playwright stdio and all_pass binary criteria; scored/{polish,visual}/judge.toml:1-22 and scored/functional/judge.toml:1-27 have weighted_mean. Functional alone has verifier command /usr/local/bin/python3 with /tests/tools/restart_mcp.py and literal $APP_RESTART_HELPER at lines 14-18. test.sh:127-193 creates, substitutes, chmods and exports that helper before suites at 213/224; restart_mcp.py:9,13-21 consumes the argument and exposes restart_app. Functional prompt.md:3,49 directs its single use. No model/reasoning_effort/temperature/weight occurs inside [judge].
Independent Python tomllib assertions passed for every shipped criterion: 1 constraints + 1 render + 145 functional + 4 polish + 5 visual = 156; criterion weight sums respectively 1,1,45,9,6. IDs are unique per file, weights positive finite, names/IDs/descriptions nonempty, all gates and functional/polish binary, and all 5 visual criteria likert with points=5. Correct suite directories exist. Every referenced prompt.md exists and has one {app_context} and {criteria}; test.sh:195-200 performs context injection. All full criterion descriptions and app_context text were independently verified inside their installed-parser resolved prompts, with no remaining placeholders.
Raw index SHA256 44a021e35f91308c5a0ac4a377682a94aeb37b49f8280bec70eeb52ef5f6a287: all 150 indexed artifact hashes match. Installed parser evidence local/uncached-inspection/configured-inspection/results.json SHA256 846bbc329dd21dae7950550587f858211460d50d6820ae5b459b52f38449b808 has 15 recorded tests source hashes, all independently matched to the frozen task. It records successful discovery/schema/prompt construction for all dimensions, no unresolved placeholders and argument_launch_exit=0 for all five; functional prompt is 109199 bytes. Read driver shows the argument launch deliberately uses /usr/bin/true, so this supports argv size feasibility only, not execution of a Claude grade or MCP connection. The exact parser output preserves the expected configured model; the task judge files themselves do not override it.
No structural counterexample was found. This Pass is limited to structural completeness and resolution. Provider grading, full configured duration, private deterministic checker execution and portal/Oracle/model results are unmeasured and are not established or waived by this row. The inspected raw shared-helper runtime behavior is separate from whether its declaration/export is structurally wired; this row makes no success claim about process replacement.
counterexample: Considered a polished seed-only/static app with correct schema: the wiring still dispatches both zero-weight gates, including hro_gate_shared (gates/constraints/judge.toml:18-26), whose two novel UI creations and independent-context readback cannot be established by an unchanged seed or localStorage-only writes. This is a source counterexample analysis, not a measured weak-app grade. Considered a conforming implementation using generated IDs, a different route layout and different control labels: functional prompt.md:13 and app_context.md:25-27 expressly allow discovery and actual generated IDs, and the structural parser includes every criterion without a route-specific template substitution. No structural false-pass/false-fail identified for these alternatives.
